Class NativeLibrary

java.lang.Object
smile.linalg.NativeLibrary
public final class NativeLibrary extends Object
Resolver and loader for SMILE's jextract-generated linear algebra bindings, mirroring smile.onnx.NativeLibrary for the ONNX Runtime.

The generated bindings obtain their symbols through SymbolLookup.libraryLookup(System.mapLibraryName(name)), which calls dlopen on a bare name. That lookup consults neither java.library.path nor LD_LIBRARY_PATH, and on macOS the system integrity protection (SIP) strips DYLD_* variables when the JVM is started through the /usr/bin/java stub. A Homebrew libarpack.dylib is therefore not found unless the working directory happens to contain it — which used to force a copy or symlink.

An explicit absolute-path System.load does not go through dyld's name search, so SIP cannot interfere with it. Loading the library first binds the image into the process; the binding's SymbolLookup.loaderLookup() then resolves the symbols from that image.

Resolution order

  1. a JVM system property (e.g. -Darpack.native.path)
  2. an environment variable (e.g. ARPACK_NATIVE_PATH)
  3. the well-known installation directories for the platform
  4. PATH / LD_LIBRARY_PATH / DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH

The search-path scan deliberately skips System32 and SysWOW64, so a stale Windows system copy is never treated as the intended one.

    • resolveDir

      public static String resolveDir(String property, String env, String bareName)
      Resolves the directory holding a mapped native library.

      An explicitly configured system property or environment variable wins outright, even if the named library is not actually there: silently falling back to a different copy found on the search path would be worse than letting the load fail with an honest "not found". The well-known directories and the search path are consulted only when neither is set.

      Parameters:
      property - the JVM system property name (may be null).
      env - the environment variable name (may be null).
      bareName - the bare library stem, e.g. arpack.
      Returns:
      the absolute directory path, or null when not found.

    • ensureLoaded

      public static boolean ensureLoaded(String property, String env, String bareName)
      Loads a native library by absolute path, at most once per library stem.

      Safe to call from several classes' static initializers: the first call performs the load, later calls are no-ops. A failure to load is swallowed — the caller's own native lookup will produce a clearer error than this best-effort preload could.

      Parameters:
      property - the JVM system property name (may be null).
      env - the environment variable name (may be null).
      bareName - the bare library stem, e.g. arpack.
      Returns:
      true when the library is loaded after this call.
